 Judgment

Heard Smt.P.R.Bentur, learned counsel for the appellant and Sri.Chandrashekhar Hosamani and Sri.N.R.Kuppelur, learned counsels for the respondents.
2.
In respect of a road traffic accident that occurred on 05.11.2005 at about 9.30 a.m. involving a KSRTC bus bearing No.KA-25/B-7023, the inmates of the bus have preferred the claim petition.
3. The claim petition, on contest, came to be allowed in part and liability was fastened on to the KSRTC.
4. Being aggrieved by the same, KSRTC is in appeal.

5. Reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal memorandum, Smt.P.R.Bentur, learned counsel for the appellant contended that as on the date of the accident, the KSRTC bus was hired bus and it had valid insurance policy and liability on KSRTC is to be exonerated and NC: 2024:KHC-D:1109 Insurance Company of the hired bus is to be made liable for payment of compensation.

6. In this regard, she also placed on record the order passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in MFA No.23698/2011 dated 22.05.2012, which was in respect of another claim involved in the same accident.
7. Per contra, Sri.N.R.Kuppelur and Sri.Chandrashekhar Hosamani, learned counsel for the respondents supported the impugned judgment and award.
8. In view of the rival contentions of the parties, this Court perused the material on record and also the order passed in MFA No.23698/2011 meticulously.

sentences.text: In MFA No.23698/2011, Smt.Mangla, who is an inmate of the offending bus as on the date of the accident, had preferred the claim petition.

The said claim petition was also allowed in part and KSRTC questioned its liability on the ground that the bus was hired bus and it had the NC:
2024:KHC-D:1109 valid insurance and the Insurance Company namely United India Insurance Company is liable to pay the compensation.
The said appeal, on contest, came to be allowed.

10. Therefore, following the principles of law enunciated in the said judgment, the present appeal needs to be allowed and the adjudged compensation is ordered to be payable by the United India Insurance Company.

11. In view of the foregoing discussion, following order is passed:
ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed.
(ii) The appellant - KSRTC is exonerated from liability to pay the adjudged compensation.

(iii) The adjudged compensation in a sum of Rs.1,52,400/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till realisation is ordered to be paid by respondent No.3 - United NC: 2024:KHC-D:1109 India Insurance Company within a period of four weeks from today.
(iv) Amount in deposit, if any, is ordered to be  returned to the KSRTC, under due  identification.
(v) Ordered accordingly.
